adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration builds an INSERT via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. Since `h` comes from the legacy `site_settings` value and is not escaped/quoted safely, any host containing a single quote will produce invalid SQL and abort the migration (and it also creates an injection risk within the migration).
